$comment: MCP servers for this project. Supabase points at the family app's project 'home' (organization 'Lan', ref qjqekazawirrpwnwgbhd). The old 'sparx studio' pipeline project was nmazktgrwachwjfewxdn. Claude-in-Chrome drives a real browser for supervised steps.

supabase.$note: Authenticate after adding: run `claude /mcp`, select supabase, Authenticate. Equivalent CLI: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http supabase "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp?project_ref=qjqekazawirrpwnwgbhd&features=docs%2Caccount%2Cdatabase%2Cdebugging%2Cdevelopment%2Cfunctions%2Cbranching"

claude-in-chrome.$note: Interactive/supervised browser control via the Claude in Chrome extension.

filesystem.$note: Deliberately scoped to this project directory ('.', resolved from the repo root) rather than the whole home directory — a narrow sandbox keeps tool output small and avoids exposing unrelated files. Claude Desktop needs an absolute path instead; see docs/MCP-Setup.md.

github.$note: The token is expanded from the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable at launch. Never paste a real token into this file — it is committed to the repo.
